label: Rest / burnout
user_text: I keep telling myself I'll rest this weekend, but I always find one more thing to do. I'm tired but I can't seem to stop.

label: Relationship
user_text: My partner and I had the same argument again. I shut down. I don't know how to say what I actually need.

label: Hard to name feelings
user_text: People ask how I am and I say 'fine.' I'm not fine. I'm not sure what I feel, just kind of numb.

label: Career / emptiness
user_text: I got praise at work but I feel empty. I'm wondering if I'm in the wrong life, and that scares me.
